semantics: Unarmed creation is classified before observer IID/description/output reads. Legal ROW_MAJOR buffers retain their original fields and original dispatch.
One selected admission consumes its role and freezes its parent occurrence, then commits one original ENTRY before delegation. Original HRESULT/output definedness and void returns are preserved.
No mutex spans an original delegate. Unknown/fault/quota metadata never rejects, replaces or retries the original call.
One source/core control context, no public reset/teardown; six app controls accept only ABI/nonce/enabled, roles/sequences, opaque tokens and byte output capacity.
Each Retain issues a distinct checked ownership alias sharing the same payload pin; each Drop retires one alias once. Detached byte copies are outside retained-ticket quotas.

New outer purpose/schema nests the complete frozen getter wire. Its frozen auditor is invoked once per receipt, and its entire result remains under getter_audit. Healthy outer creation counters are causally bounded by original source and ignored-call counters. Inner fault/gap propagates outward, never conversely assumed.
Mock API argument lineage remains separate from descriptor contents, loaded code, backing, rendering and GPU reads.
